description: This file defines protocols for streaming audio playback, namely StreamingAudioPlaying and PCMStreamingAudioPlaying, and extends existing classes to conform to these protocols.

classes.name: StreamingAudioPlaying
classes.description: Protocol defining methods for streaming audio playback.

classes.name: PCMStreamingAudioPlaying
classes.description: Protocol for PCM streaming audio playback with sample rate parameter.

methods.name: play(stream:asynctryingstream<Data, Error>)
methods.description: Begins playback of the provided async stream of data.

methods.name: stop()
methods.description: Stops playback and returns an optional Double, perhaps representing a timestamp or duration.

methods.name: play(stream:asynctryingstream<Data, Error>, sampleRate: Double)
methods.description: Begins PCM playback with specified sample rate.
